extracted.intended_audience: local and state government officials, procurement officers, IT/finance leaders, and public servants evaluating municipal software
extracted.subtask_description: Evaluating or selecting enterprise software products aimed at local and state governments (asset management, permitting, budgeting, procurement, tax & revenue, financial management) focusing on functional modules, integrations, support, and outcomes like efficiency and public trust.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enterprise Asset Management
rubrics_metrics.description: Enterprise Asset Management helps you plan smarter, respond faster, and make data-backed decisions with tools built for the unique demands of local and state governments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Key Features: Work Order Management; Asset Lifecycle Tracking; Infrastructure Planning; Reporting & Dashboards; Real-Time GIS Integration; Mobile App. Evaluate whether the system supports planning, lifecycle tracking, GIS, mobile field use, and actionable reporting for infrastructure assets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Permitting & Licensing
rubrics_metrics.description: OpenGov Permitting & Licensing helps you cut through the red tape with the most adaptable AI-enabled software built for the real-world needs of local and state governments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Key Features: Intuitive Applicant Portal; Workflow Automation and Approvals; Self-Service System and Tools; Virtual Front Desk; Mobile App for Inspections; Automated Renewals. Consider applicant UX, workflow automation, mobile inspection capabilities, virtual/front-desk functionality, and AI-enabled adaptability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budgeting & Performance
rubrics_metrics.description: OpenGov Budgeting & Performance helps local and state governments set goals and manage operational, capital, and workforce budgets with confidence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Built-in transparency, seamless ERP integration, and powerful reporting tools. Key Features: Performance Management; Advanced Workflow Management; Operating Budget; Capital and Workforce Planning; Powerful Analytics and Reporting; Digital Budget Book Builder. Assess transparency, ERP integration, analytics, and tools for aligning dollars to goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procurement & Contract Management
rubrics_metrics.description: OpenGov Procurement & Contract Management brings the entire process together with workflow automation and AI built for local and state governments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Key Features: Request Management; Intake Management; Solicitation Assembly; Supplier Engagement; Group Evaluations; Contract Management. Evaluate end-to-end procurement workflows, automation, supplier engagement features, evaluative scoring/group evaluations, contract lifecycle controls, and compliance support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tax & Revenue Collection
rubrics_metrics.description: OpenGov Tax & Revenue Collection centralizes tax billing, filing, and payments in one place to improve collections, reduce administrative headaches, and deliver better service.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Key Features: Revenue Workflows; Self-Service Portal; Dynamic Calculations; Real-Time Analytics; State & Local Data Interfaces; E-Delivery Options. Consider accuracy of calculations, self-service taxpayer portals, analytics for collections, and integrations with state/local data flows and e-delivery.

rubrics_metrics.name: Financial Management
rubrics_metrics.description: OpenGov Financial Management brings it all together in one modern platform, including general ledger, accounts payable, budgeting, procurement, and reporting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Key Features/Capabilities: Inquiry, reporting, and analysis; Digital workflows; Digital documentation; Auto-validations for Departments; Integrated Spend Controls; Expert Services Support. Assess core financial modules, digital workflows and documentation, departmental validations, spend controls, and availability of professional services.

rubrics_metrics.name: Built for Local and State Government (domain fit)
rubrics_metrics.description: Become more strategic, responsive, resilient, and efficient with OpenGov.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Claims the platform is purpose-built for unique demands of local/state governments. Evaluate domain-specific configurations, templates, regulatory fit, and whether the product reflects public-sector workflows and constraints.

rubrics_metrics.name: AI-enabled functionality
rubrics_metrics.description: AI-enabled software built for the real-world needs of local and state governments (mentioned specifically in Permitting & Licensing and Procurement).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess the role AI plays (automation, decision-support, applicant experience), its reliability, transparency, potential biases, and how it reduces manual work and delays.

rubrics_metrics.name: Integrations and Open APIs
rubrics_metrics.description: Powered by open APIs and robust integrations—one secure, connected system.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate ability to integrate with existing ERPs, state/local data interfaces, GIS, and other systems via APIs; consider data flows, synchronization, and vendor-provided connectors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Security and One Connected System
rubrics_metrics.description: One secure, connected system, purpose-built for modern government.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess security posture, single-platform data model, access controls, and how connectivity across modules preserves data integrity and reduces silos.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reporting, Analytics, and Dashboards
rubrics_metrics.description: Intuitive dashboards and powerful reporting tools to move faster, plan smarter, and align every dollar to what matters most.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate built-in analytics, dashboard configurability, real-time reporting, and support for performance management and public transparency (e.g., digital budget books).

rubrics_metrics.name: Mobile Capabilities
rubrics_metrics.description: Mobile App (mentioned across modules, e.g., EAM mobile app, mobile app for inspections).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate mobile apps for field workflows (work orders, inspections), offline capabilities, inspection/photo capture, ease-of-use for front-line staff, and mobile security.

rubrics_metrics.name: Customer Success / Professional Services and Support
rubrics_metrics.description: OpenGov's professional services team is full of former public servants who know best practices, and the team sticks with customers beyond implementation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess implementation track record, availability of subject-matter experts, training/onboarding, ongoing support, and vendor commitment to customer success (over-communication through challenges).

rubrics_metrics.name: Proven Implementation and Social Proof
rubrics_metrics.description: With 4,500+ successful software implementations and trusted by 2,000 Governments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use counts/testimonials as evidence of maturity; evaluate case studies, references (e.g., finance director quotes), and measurable outcomes from similar jurisdictions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Operational Outcomes / Value Propositions
rubrics_metrics.description: Operate Efficiently; Adapt To Change; Strengthen Public Trust — promises about outcomes the platform enables.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When evaluating, seek evidence that the software increases operational efficiency, enables change/adaptation, and supports transparency that builds public trust (metrics, success stories, time/cost savings).
